title.ru: Исследование о происхождении наших идей красоты и добродетели
title.en: An Inquiry into the Original of Our Ideas of Beauty and Virtue

conceptions.locus: Treatise I, section VI, article X

thesis.ru: Внутреннее чувство есть пассивная способность получать идеи красоты от всех предметов, в которых есть единообразие среди разнообразия.
thesis.en: The internal sense is a passive power of receiving ideas of beauty from all objects in which there is uniformity amidst variety.

conceptions.note: A:E010 is grounded in the author’s definition rather than the edition description. B:C-I034 is narrowed to this definition; aesthetic value and perfection are not named in this sentence.

conceptions.locus: Treatise I, section I, article XII

thesis.ru: Удовольствие от красоты отлично от знания принципов, соотношений, причин или полезности предмета; красота поражает нас сразу.
thesis.en: The pleasure of beauty is different from knowledge of principles, proportions, causes, or the usefulness of the object; beauty strikes us at first.

conceptions.note: The passage distinguishes immediate pleasure from knowledge of usefulness; it does not here speak of comparison by possession or of social agreement.

conceptions.locus: Treatise I, section II, article III

thesis.ru: Фигуры, возбуждающие в нас идеи красоты, представляются такими, в которых есть единообразие среди разнообразия.
thesis.en: The figures which excite in us ideas of beauty seem to be those in which there is uniformity amidst variety.

conceptions.note: The original qualifies the claim as an appearance and identifies figures that excite ideas of beauty.

verb.ru: по-видимому, присутствует в фигурах, возбуждающих идеи
verb.en: seems present in figures that excite ideas of

links.note: The author qualifies the identification of figures with uniformity amidst variety as those that excite ideas of beauty.
